catalogue.governanceBody: Creating, changing, publishing, activating and deactivating violations and penalties all happen through a compliance configuration request. This catalogue does not skip that process.
catalogue.readerNote: Your role can view this catalogue. Changing it needs the compliance-admin or form-admin role, enforced by row-level security.
catalogue.lensIntro: What the database checks when a mapping is created. Every rule below is enforced, not advisory.
catalogue.lensRule1: One violation carries at most one mapping — a second is rejected by a unique constraint.
catalogue.lensRule2: Legal basis must be present before a mapping is created; it is never inferred.
catalogue.lensRule3: Maker-checker: the approver must differ from the creator.
catalogue.lensRule4: A published link cannot change. To change it, publish a new one.
catalogue.degradedTitle: The violation catalogue could not be read
catalogue.degradedBody: No count is claimed. The catalogue is unavailable, which is not the same as empty.
catalogue.emptyBody: The read succeeded and returned none. Violations are configured through a compliance configuration request.
catalogue.catalogueFootnote: Answers in the form raise violations. An inspector cannot type one or change one. The legal basis comes from the penalty list, not from the code. List codes are separate from real violations. We keep a record of every change.
catalogue.penaltyFootnote: One violation, one penalty — the database rejects a second mapping. Range and repeat presets are fixed choices, never money amounts or legal wording.

code.triggersEmpty: No item response mapping currently references this code.
code.triggersUnavailable: The inspection items could not be read — this is not a claim that none reference this code.
code.derivation: Lifecycle derived from active-from {from} and active-to {to}, as of {today} in Riyadh.

mapping.unmappedBody: No penalty mapping exists for this violation. One is required before the violation can carry an enforcement outcome.
